# Shipping label maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/shipping-label/

Create an address label with sender, recipient, package reference and optional notes on common label or paper sizes.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Prepare a 100 × 150 mm parcel address label and export a PDF for printing.

## Limits and checks

This is an address label, not purchased postage, a carrier tracking number, a customs declaration or proof that a parcel was accepted.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
